Container.Name: multivibe-host
Container.Overview: MultiVibe Host connects AI provider accounts through an API proxy and local dashboard. Application data and credentials persist in appdata.
Container.Requires: Unraid on x86_64. Set the Public URL to the exact LAN or HTTPS reverse-proxy origin used by browsers.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Host port for the protected MultiVibe dashboard and API.

Config.Name: Application data
Config.Description: Persistent private credentials, device identity, policy, database and logs.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Required: enter your actual origin, for example http://192.168.1.10:1455. Match the Web UI host port; do not use [IP] or [PORT] placeholders. No path or trailing slash. Use the reverse-proxy HTTPS origin when applicable.
